name: Bad Juju

frame.name: String of Curses
frame.description: Kills refill the magazine, increase damage for a short duration, and grant Super energy based on the strength of String of Curses. Fires full-auto.

perks.name: Steady Rounds
perks.description:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.description: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Short-Action Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is especially easy to grip.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed

perks.name: Full Auto Trigger System
perks.description: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto.

flavor: "If you believe your weapon wants to end all existence, then so it will." —Toland the Shattered

catalyst.name: Bad Juju Catalyst
catalyst.description: Extends the duration of String of Curses.
